massing_review.observed: Compared native pavilion mass, front upstand, crown and side return to opposing loaded 3D orbits and a clearer street photograph. Retained the approximate primary rise; replaced the blank tower front and exposed brick side with a pediment, circular opening and substantial raised sandstone return. The adjoining roof has a steep-to-shallow break, clipped dormer valleys, rooflights and stack footprints. The stepped return has a visibly projecting cap, modelled as a continuous separate owner. The red neighbour owns the common party skin; the bank keeps only the exposed wedge above that roof, using its declared layout input.
massing_review.remaining: Roof and ornament dimensions are image estimates; the cap and crest are simplified. The exact neighbouring side and private court remain partially hidden.
